scenes.title: How kokoro-cli speaks
scenes.subtitle: Text to speech that stays on your computer
scenes.say: This is how kokoro C L I turns text into speech, without sending your text anywhere.

scenes.title: Three steps, all local
points: Play each sentence as soon as it is ready
scenes.say: First, the text is split into sentences. Then the Kokoro model turns each sentence into sound. Finally, each sentence plays as soon as it is ready.

scenes.title: One command
scenes.subtitle: Write the phrase after the command.
scenes.say: To try it, run one command. Add dash v to pick a voice, or dash o to save a file.

scenes.title: Or call it from Node
scenes.say: You can also call it from your own code, to play speech or save it to a file.

scenes.title: npx kokoro-cli
scenes.subtitle: No API key. No server.
scenes.say: That is all. No key, and no server.
